headline: Khor Fakkan tug strike CONFIRMED via Reuters/Arab News + UKMTO advisory 177-26
dek: Khor Fakkan tug strike (1500-04) now CONFIRMED by multi-source relay: UKMTO advisory 177-26 (Oct 18): 'A tug travelling southbound has reported being struck by 2 unknown projectiles' NE of Khor Fakkan, UAE; damage, 1 minor casualty, vessel continuing. Reuters (via Arab News, Oct 18) confirms.
sources: UKMTO advisory 177-26 + Reuters wire via Arab News / Hindustan Times
fault_line: The strait war the US says it’s winning (97% get through, Cooper) vs the collapse Kpler measured (8.5M bpd): who’s counting right?

sections.what_happened: Khor Fakkan tug strike (1500-04) now CONFIRMED by multi-source relay: UKMTO advisory 177-26 (Oct 18): 'A tug travelling southbound has reported being struck by 2 unknown projectiles' NE of Khor Fakkan, UAE; damage, 1 minor casualty, vessel continuing. Reuters (via Arab News, Oct 18) confirms. Two MORE incidents same window: (a) 140nm SE of Al Mukalla, Yemen: small boat with 7 people fired 2 shots at an LNG tanker; armed security team returned warning shots, boat changed course (UKMTO via Aaj TV). (b) Saturday: vessel struck by unknown projectile 68nm NE of Al Jubail, Saudi Arabia — crew safe/evacuated (UKMTO via HT). UKMTO weekly maritime report (Friday): actual attack numbers 'could be significantly higher than official figures' — most targeted vessels refusing to report. UKMTO weekly review: 135 incidents in the Strait amid the conflict (ANI).
sections.what_verified: Reuters (Arab News, Arab News PK), Hindustan Times quoting UKMTO advisory text directly, Rudaw, Aaj TV, Arab Times Online — all consistent with the 1500-04 claim (upgrade from Unverified). Exact advisory reference number 177-26 confirms official issuance.
sections.what_disputed: No attribution of responsibility in any source — all actors unidentified. Exact incident time 'not confirmed' (UKMTO). RTV English inflated casualties ('heavy damage and serious injuries') vs official 'one minor casualty' — outlier, discarded. IRGC claim (ISNA via ANI) that a 2M-barrel 'illegal supertanker' was mine-hit with severe fire = SINGLE-SOURCE Iranian state claim, unverified — keep HOLD.
sections.why_matters: A tug off the UAE, an LNG tanker off Yemen, a vessel off Jubail — and the watchdog admits most attacks go unreported. The shipping war is bigger than the official numbers. TOTW follows the ships, not the press releases.
sections.context: Background: Gulf shipping — VERIFICATION UPGRADE (extends 1500-04 HOLD): Khor Fakkan tug strike CONFIRMED via Reuters/Arab News + UKMTO advisory 177-26; +2 more incidents in window

totw_analysis: Our read: A tug off the UAE, an LNG tanker off Yemen, a vessel off Jubail — and the watchdog admits most attacks go unreported. The shipping war is bigger than the official numbers. TOTW follows the ships, not the press releases.
